Taiwan: fertilizer companies → farmland (19 counties, real road routing)

2.79M real farmland parcels aggregated into 346 township-level demand nodes across 19 counties (743,529 ha total). 616 registered fertilizer/agrochemical companies. Routing stays within each company's own county — a company only links to farmland nodes in the same county, never to farmland far away. Distance/time via real OSRM road routing.
